page.layout: One page of text, one column; running head at top with page number left and chapter title right; catchword at lower right of text block.

main_text.p: ius sui instituti rationem Paulus affert: neque enim existimandum est quemquam nisi grauissimis causis adductum, propria commoda prorsus negligere, aliena autem tam anxiè curare velle. Rationes hæ sunt, æterna multorum salus, temporali vnius commodo infinitis gradibus præferenda est.

page.notes: The catchword "Cap." is partly visible at the right edge and is uncertain. The running head reads "Cap.10" at the top right, which I have rendered as "Cap. 10"; the numeral may be "ro" (10) in the printed form. Some words in the first line are partly obscured by a vertical scan line; "ius sui instituti" and "rationem" are read with reasonable confidence. Show-through and scan artefacts were disregarded.
